Welcome
Welcome from the Head of School. It is my pleasure to welcome you to Oak Hill School where boys and girls can find a nurturing, inclusive and vibrant setting in which to develop their social, creative and academic skills. We are relentless in our quest to understand the needs of our students so that we can deliver targeted pastoral support and teaching of behaviour to facilitate high quality learning experiences. We work with our partners to deliver a curriculum that is varied, stimulating and sympathetic to the different individual needs of our learners.

Maths
Welcome to our Mathematics department! On this page you will be able to see what our Mathematics department has to offer and if you need any further information, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Our Maths department are focused on developing our students’ numerical abilities, problem solving skills and comprehension of statistics and data in an ever-increasing technological world.
We also provide a range of enriching interactive activities outside of the classroom throughout the week.
Students are encouraged and supported in relating classroom concepts to the real world in order to apply knowledge and transition these skills into Maths related careers:
Business / Economics
Software development / Computer Programming
Accounting
Teaching
Engineering

Music therapy
Delivered by: Resources for Autism
Music therapy uses music, words and play to create a safe, contained space and foster a positive therapeutic relationship. A music therapist draws on a range of approaches to music (including improvisation, song writing, turn-taking games and musical activities) in their work to develop aims suited to the needs of each individual. These sessions may be 1:1 or in a small group.
The benefits of music therapy can include:
Enhanced communication and self-expression
Emotional regulation and reduced anxiety
Developed awareness of self and others
Improved listening skills and capacity to share
Increased focus and concentration span
More flexible and creative play

Science
Welcome to the Science department! The department’s main focus is for students to develop ideas to explain the world around us and to learn scientific skills.
Science matters. That’s why we’ve built a variety of qualifications, so every student can enjoy Science and succeed in their studies. In Key Stage 3, students complete a variety of topics in the three sciences (Biology, Chemistry, and Physics) which ultimately prepares them for their Science studies in Key Stage 4. We are currently offering the following qualifications at Key Stage 4:
Please see below the examples of careers in Science:
BTEC Firsts Applied Science
GCSE Biology (AQA)
GCSE Combined Science (AQA)

Art
The Art Department is an important part of the curriculum at Oak Hill. Visual Arts present an opportunity to be creative and innovative in ways that many other subjects can’t. At KS4 particularly, students are able to work in smaller groups to their own capabilities and pace. Qualifications from ASDAN to GCSE are also encouraged and students may also chose it as an enrichment subject when it is used often in a therapeutic way.
Below are some examples of careers where art is essential:-
Gaming design, CAD, animation and film.
Graphic design/ Illustration.
Architecture or interior design.
Costume design/ Fashion.
Furniture design.
Comic book artist.

Bereavement therapy
One child in every UK classroom will experience the death of someone close by the time they reach 16 years old Grief Encounter work closely with individuals, families, schools and professionals to offer a way through the anxiety, fear and isolation so often caused by grief. They are there to help alleviate the pain and confusion caused by the death of a parent or sibling. Bereavement is devastating at any age, but for a child it is life-changing.
